label: The goods are a listed hazardous substance
definition: The goods appear in a statutory schedule of hazardous chemicals or wastes, so handling them attracts licensing, packaging, labelling, transport-document and emergency-response obligations that do not attach to ordinary goods, and liability for escape is strict rather than fault-based.

authority.act: Manufacture, Storage and Import of Hazardous Chemical Rules, 1989
authority.note: The list of hazardous chemicals. This is the enumeration to import.

authority.act: Manufacture, Storage and Import of Hazardous Chemical Rules, 1989
authority.note: Duties of the occupier; on-site emergency plan above threshold quantities.

authority.act: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
authority.note: Hazardous waste categories, and the manifest system for movement.
Transport of dangerous or hazardous goods: driver training, emergency information panel, class labels, licensing of the vehicle.
No person shall discharge or emit any pollutant in excess of prescribed standards.
Compulsory insurance for handling hazardous substances.

requires_dimensions.note: The dimension gate is doing real work here. Polypropylene granules in transport attract NOTHING under this concept; toluene in transport attracts all of it. Keying on the goods description alone gets this wrong in both directions.

above_threshold_quantity.note: MSIHC threshold quantities decide whether an on-site emergency plan and a Major Accident Hazard classification apply.

b_lexicon.source_of_truth: MSIHC Rules 1989, Schedule 1 — published list of hazardous chemicals
Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules 2016, Schedules I-III

d_classifier.note: May only return HAZARDOUS_MATERIAL, AMBIGUOUS, or OUTSIDE_KNOWN_SET, and must quote the span it read. It may not name a chemical that is absent from the imported schedules.

confirmation.question: Are any of the goods flammable, corrosive, toxic, explosive, or otherwise classified as hazardous or dangerous?
confirmation.why: Hazardous goods carry licensing, labelling and transport rules, and liability for a spill does not depend on anyone being at fault. The agreement needs to say who carries that risk.

unresolved_behaviour.rationale: This concept currently attaches no clauses, so 'present' would change nothing while implying it had. The only honest output while clauses_to_author is non-empty is the OUTSIDE_KNOWN_SET disclosure: tell the user plainly that the document does not address hazardous-goods regulation and that an advocate should review it before signing.

authoring_note: There is not one clause in the 297-clause library matching HAZARD, SAFETY or ENVIRON. Detection for this concept is the easy half; the seven clauses listed in clauses_to_author are the real cost, and until they exist this concept can only disclose its own ignorance.
